scope: Prospective finite_flat_dynamic_stop_resume_dwell_v1 only; original profiles retain their original behavior and receipts
arrival: Original raw SLAM ArrivalWindow control-region0.17m, dwell0.6sim s, integer source stamps, original0.2s maximum arrival-pose gap and90sim s deadline unchanged. Zero for arrival begins only when that original window returns arrived=true. Native obstacle/path-end/tilt/stale zero stops remain immediate.
continuity: While obstacle_hold is active, reset original clear_since before shared control if current ROS clock minus previous actual guard clock exceeds0.3s. Exact current raw SLAM and registered-cloud header ages must be within original0.3s source TTL. A cached tick reaching1s cannot release; wait for the next already scheduled native guard, without any additional geometry calculation. Actual guard clock duplicate/backward fails closed.

native_guard_trace_additions.previous_actual_guard_clock_ns: Exact previous invocation ROS clock integer, never a status sample or scheduled fictitious check
native_guard_trace_additions.clear_guard_continuity_resets: Cumulative real clear-timer reset evidence rows
native_guard_trace_additions.clear_release_requires_this_callback_act: True for this profile; actual release must be present in the same actual guard row

reset_history.geometry: extra_geometry_computed always false; this record is a clock/source safety reset, never an obstacle evaluation
reset_history.writer_count: Shutdown navigation_guard_writer_receipt.json clear_guard_continuity_resets must equal reset-history line count; expected_records still counts original actual native guard invocations only

acceptance: Original continuous actual guard span >=1sim s with gap<=0.3s, same real parking/withdrawal/new SCAN/resume/2regions/final stop/clean children requirements. No old result is re-evaluated or upgraded by this schema.
